October 14, 2014. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the Council
with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person must ask
the Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item from the
Consent Calendar for discussion.

minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  October 8, 2014
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Committee Members King, Leach and Vice-Chair Kao, present.
  Committee Member Beall arrived at approximately 7:45 p.m.
  Chairman Buss arrived at approximately 8:35 p.m. (previously notified)

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
 None

OLD BUSINESS
1. Malaga Cove Plaza Area Parking Issues.

  a) Traffic Safety Committee Chair Buss moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member King) to recommend that Staff coordinate with the Malaga Cove Plaza business
  community and return to the Committee with specific recommendations to adjust time
  limit parking hours at various locations throughout the Malaga Cove Plaza area. The
  vote was 5 in favor.

  b) Traffic Safety Committee Member Leach moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member King) to recommend that Staff pursue further actions and return to the
  Committee regarding construction to provide additional parking along the north side of
  Via Tejon east of Via Chico. The vote was 5 in favor.

  c) Traffic Safety Committee Vice-Chair Kao moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member Beall) to recommend that Staff pursue further actions and return to the
  Committee regarding time limit exempt parking permits for Malaga Cove Plaza
  businesses. The vote was 5 in favor.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on Item 1 on Tuesday, October 28, 2014 and all other items on
  Tuesday, October 14, 2014. .

Traffic Safety Committee  1  Planning & Building Director  SR-L
Action Memo
October 8, 2014
   d) Traffic Safety Committee Chair Buss moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member King) to recommend that Staff pursue further actions and return to the
  Committee regarding evaluating enhancements to make underutilized parking locations
  more attractive. The vote was 5 in favor.

NEW BUSINESS
2. Granvia Altamira at Via Cerritos Entrance Island.

  Traffic Safety Committee Chair Buss moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee Vice-
  Chair Kao) to recommend that Staff: 1) Modify and straighten the painted edgeline on the
  east side of Granvia Altamira (northbound direction) extending from Rancho Palos Verdes
  into the City; 2) Shift the painted edge line on the west side of Granvia Altamira (southbound
  direction) further away from the curb to provide a 10 foot southbound travel lane; and, 3)
  Reduce the median radius on the south end to reduce the bulb width from 22 feet to 18 feet
  and modify the reverse taper to extend the left-turn bay. The vote was 4-1 (Beall opposed).

RESIDENT LETTERS
3. Various Traffic Issues – Deborah Gaume.

  Action:  No further action.

4. Palos Verdes Intermediate School Traffic Issues – Paula Leeds

  Action: Traffic Safety Committee member Beall moved (seconded by Traffic Safety
  Committee member Leach) to recommend that Staff review traffic conditions and report
  back to the Committee. The vote was 5 in favor.
